title: Callback
description: projectkit contract v1.4.0 — the RESULT of executing a dispatched Concern, returned by a dispatch adapter (webhook POST) or fetched by the testbed (poll). Cross-language mirror of src/dispatch.ts (Callback). Keyed by concern_ref back to the originating Concern. This is the return leg that makes dispatch a two-way seam, so mesh is ONE swappable dispatch adapter rather than the owner of dispatch/poll routes. A consumer tolerates 1.3.0–1.4.0. v1.4.0 adds optional error_code (machine-readable failure category) and artifact media metadata (content_type/byte_size/duration_ms).

content_type.description: MIME type of the artifact, e.g. video/webm | image/png. (v1.4.0)

byte_size.description: Size of the artifact in bytes. Matches capture-overlay's chunk-manifest byte_size naming. (v1.4.0)

duration_ms.description: Duration for time-based media (audio/video/replay), in ms. (v1.4.0)

error_code.description: Machine-readable failure category when status is failed/cancelled. Open string. Well-known: timeout | permission | validation | execution | cancelled. (v1.4.0)
